channel.title: Vice City Feed
channel.description: Vice City Feed is an independent editorial desk covering Grand Theft Auto VI — Leonida leaks, map lore, mission intel, vehicles, mods, and reviews.

item.title: Leonida's Map Is Bigger Than You Think — Here's How It Compares
item.description: Vice City is only the headline. We measured islands, highways, and the Keys against San Andreas and Los Santos — and the playable landmass is a different conversation.
item.author: Rico Alvarez

item.title: Jason & Lucia: How Dual Protagonists Rewrite the Heist
item.description: Switching between Jason and Lucia is not a gimmick. It is a pacing tool, a stealth layer, and the reason Vice City's story jobs feel like two movies spliced into one getaway.
item.author: Maya Chen

item.title: Garage Deep Dive: Vice City Customization Is Next-Gen
item.description: Liveries, stance, underglow, and a parts economy that actually matters. The garage is no longer a menu — it's a second hideout.
item.author: Jordan Hale

item.title: The 2026 Leak Roundup: Confirmed Intel vs. Fan Fiction
item.description: A sober ledger of what leaked, what Rockstar has effectively confirmed, and which viral clips still belong in the rumor bin.
item.author: Alex Voss

item.title: Mission Intel: The Port Gellhorn Run — Stealth, Getaway, Timers
item.description: Loadout, split roles, and the 22-minute window that makes this the cleanest early-game Heist if you do not panic at the crane.
item.author: Samira Okonkwo

item.title: The Keys, the Swamps, and the Stories Buried in Leonida
item.description: South of the neon, the map turns quiet. We mapped folklore, wildlife encounters, and the roadside businesses that do more world-building than any cutscene.
item.author: Rico Alvarez

item.title: Weapons Bench: Guns, Ammo Types, and Crafting Firefights
item.description: Hollow points in the city, slugs in the grassrivers. Ammo is a language now — and the bench is where you learn to speak it.
item.author: Jordan Hale

item.title: Garage & Mods: What the PC Scene Should Expect After Launch
item.description: Script hooks, livery packs, and why Vice City's vehicle pipeline is the most mod-friendly Rockstar has shipped in a decade — if the toolchain lands.
item.author: Alex Voss

item.title: Neon After Dark: A Night Drive Through Vice City's Districts
item.description: Hotel row, the marina strip, and the inland clubs that never make the trailers. A guided nocturnal circuit of Leonida's capital.
item.author: Maya Chen

item.title: Trailer Frame-by-Frame: Businesses, Weather, and Police AI
item.description: We slowed the latest footage to a crawl. New storefronts, a two-stage storm cell, and cop behavior that does not match GTA V's wanted loop.
item.author: Alex Voss

item.title: Lucia Is Not a Sidekick: A Character Study of GTA 6's Lead
item.description: Rockstar's first female protagonist is written with appetite, not apology. Our review of the performance, the silence, and the jobs she refuses.
item.author: Maya Chen

item.title: First 10 Hours in Leonida: Banks, Bikes, and Not Getting Wasted
item.description: A practical opener: where to stash cash, which bikes actually handle the Keys, and the three cop patterns that end new players.
item.author: Samira Okonkwo

item.title: Review: Vice City Radio, Club Culture, and the Night Economy
item.description: Stations that argue with each other, DJs who know your last heist, and clubs that function as businesses — not just loading screens with bass.
item.author: Maya Chen

item.title: Bayside Marina Garage: The Modder's Preview We Wanted
item.description: Lift kits on boats, neon undertrays that read in rain, and a parts cage that looks designed for community liveries from day one.
item.author: Jordan Hale
